name: AudioLDM
overview: A mature text-to-audio latent diffusion model capable of generating both music and foley.
details: AudioLDM generates sound effects and ambient noise by mapping text embeddings to the latent space of a robust audio diffusion pipeline.
While it established the early baseline for text-to-sound, newer models like Stable Audio Open have largely superseded it in raw audio fidelity and structural coherence.
